editorial.blurb: A lively Mexican spot near the Metra station where excellent tequila and mezcal deals meet genuinely cared-for tacos, quesabirria, and those build-your-own nachos that actually stay crispy.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit up Tuesday nights for half-off tequilas and mezcals—the list is extensive and the bartenders (ask for Amaziah or Rodney) know their stuff and will guide you through selections.
